name: Energy World Corporation Ltd
summary: Energy World Corporation Ltd, an energy infrastructure company, engages in production and sale of power and liquefied natural gas in Australia, Indonesia, and Philippines. The company owns and operates power plant in the Philippines. It also develops liquefied natural gas (LNG) projects; and LNG hub terminals. The company was formerly known as Conversion Technology and changed its name to Energy World Corporation Ltd in 2001. Energy World Corporation Ltd was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Quarry Bay, Hong Kong.
